parsedVerdict.reasoning: src/infrastructure/http-app.ts is an Express HTTP adapter, and everything it does is infrastructure (transport) work. It defines routes and parses request bodies, path params and query params. Its validation only checks the shape of the input: is the value a string, is the body an object. It maps domain errors to HTTP status codes and turns entities into transport DTOs, for example by converting a Date to an ISO string. It also wires the service to the in-memory repositories in createTaskService. That wiring is a composition-root job, which fits the infrastructure layer. No business rules show up in the file. Task creation, listing and filtering, and marking a task done are all handed off to TaskService. Even the TaskStatus casts aren't checked here, so the domain and application layers keep that validation. Accepting both "assignee" and "assigneeId" in the query is an HTTP concern. Import direction is out of scope.
